name: Camp Jack

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

description_short: The Jack Rua Camp for Children with Diabetes: a six-week July-August day camp for kids with type 1 diabetes ages 5-14, plus their siblings and friends, held at the Camp Welch site in Assonet, MA. Campers do theme weeks with sports, swimming, crafts and nature while learning diabetes management, with nurses on site.
special_needs_notes: Built for children with type 1 diabetes: a lead RN, an RN and an LPN on site, a physician assistant as health care consultant, staff trained in T1D management, and snacks and meals planned for diabetes management. Campers must have T1D or be a sibling, relative or close friend of a camper with T1D.
swim_waterfront_notes: Campers have access to swimming pools. The brochure does not describe swim tests or lifeguarding.
